# Draft:Kingsley Onochie

----
Kingsley Onochie
Kingsley Onochie, born on September 14, 1992, is a Nigerian lawyer, Businessman and politician.[https://pmexpressng.com/barr-kingsley-onochie-hon-okafor-over-1000-pdp-apc-members-defect-to-apga/] Since 2025, he is currently the Head of Monitoring and Evaluation for the National Committee on Energy Efficiency, Innovation, and Certification.[https://leadership.ng/minister-tasks-committee-on-tinubus-sustainable-energy-agenda-2/] Prior to this role, he was the Legislative Aide to the Chairman of the House Committee on Environment and Habitat at the House of Represenatatives, National Assembly Nigeria.Chidoka
Early Life and Education
Kingsley Onochie was born on September 14, 1992, to Engineer Joseph Onochie and Dr. Mrs. Gina Onochie at Adinma Specialist Hospital in Nkpor, Anambra State, Nigeria. He began his elementary education at Premier Montessori Private School Aba, Abia State, and continued at Premier International Secondary School Aba, Abia State,[https://www.edusko.com/school/premier-international-secondary-school-aba] in 2003. He completed his secondary studies at Marist Comprehensive College Nteje, Anambra State,[https://www.edusko.com/school/marist-comprehensive-college] in 2009. In 2010, he enrolled at Cambridge Ruskin International College in Cambridge, United Kingdom, for his Foundation in Law. He was subsequently admitted to Anglia Ruskin University at the Cambridge Campus,[https://www.aru.ac.uk/international/information-by-region/nigeria?utm%20source=google%20performance%20max&utm%20medium=cpc&utm%20campaign=ec%20ug26%20nigeria&utm%20content=pg%20brand%20ads%20nigeria&gad%20source=5&gad%20campaignid=23066072561&gclid=EAIaIQobChMIt8D%2006W2kQMVdaRQBh0Y] where he earned his Bachelor of Law (LL.B.)in 2013. He further obtained a Master’s degree in International Business Law (LL.M.)[https://www.aru.ac.uk/international/information-by-region/nigeria?utm%20source=google%20performance%20max&utm%20medium=cpc&utm%20campaign=ec%20ug26%20nigeria&utm%20content=pg%20brand%20ads%20nigeria&gad%20source=5&gad%20campaignid=23066072561&gclid=EAIaIQobChMIt8D%2006W2kQMVdaRQBh0Y] in 2015 and was called to the Nigerian Bar in 2017. Currently, he is pursuing a PhD in Leadership and Strategic Studies at the Federal University, Lokoja in Kogi State, Nigeria.[https://www.fulokoja.edu.ng/]
Career
Onochie started his public sector career at the National Assembly in Abuja. Shortly after completing his National Youth Service Corps in 2016, his commitment to serving the people and promoting Nigeria’s development through a vision focused on sustainable growth and strategic alliances earned him an appointment in 2017 as the Legislative Aide to the Chairman of the House Committee on Environment and Habitat at the House of Representatives.Obinna Chidoka He leveraged this platform to further contribute to Nigeria’s national development through his dedicated service.
Following his career in the public sector, Onochie co-founded the Onochie Twins Foundation to support charitable initiatives aimed at aiding the vulnerable. In 2023, he also joined the reputable law firm CroftBridge & Co. as a Senior Partner. While in this role, he was appointed in 2025 by the Honorable Uche Nnaji, Minister of Innovation, Science, and Technology, to serve as the Head of Enforcement for the National Committee on Energy Efficiency Innovation and Certification (NCEEIC),[https://www.vanguardngr.com/2025/08/science-minister-inaugurates-nceeics-natl-committee/] aligning with President Bola Ahmed Tinubu's Renewed Hope Agenda.[https://fmino.gov.ng/fg-moves-to-provide-clean-reliable-and-affordable-energy/]
